title: Holographic interpolations of codimension-2 defect CFTs
summary: We provide a comprehensive overview of the current status of higher-codimension defect systems. We review the holographic description and field theoretic properties of codimension-2 defects within the framework of defect Conformal Field Theories (dCFTs). Starting from the well-established classification of $1/2$-BPS supersymmetric defects, we examine their realisation through probe branes and bubbling supergravity geometries.
